decisions.reason: As a multi-model line prominently shown on the home page and closely tied to the firm's traditional candle-arch craft, it embodies visible commitment and sunk effort that management is likely to continue backing.

This product sits very near the firm's established Christmas-pyramid business and was publicly featured for two years, so management has strong grounds to justify staying with it rather than admitting a mistaken launch.

Although more distant from the core craft identity, the firm invested in several models and highlighted the line on the home page, which under an escalation-of-commitment logic makes withdrawal less likely unless failure is unmistakable.
The dedicated page in 2019 suggests added commitment to this accessory platform, and management will tend to retain it at least while preserving the broader electronic music-box concept.

This seasonal accessory remained only lightly presented and is less central and less publicly committed than the main line, making it the easiest item to sacrifice while still defending the broader project.

Because it builds directly on the firm's established pyramid tradition and was prominently marketed, management is likely to keep it and interpret any weaker results as temporary rather than abandon a visible extension of its core business.
